Priya (PM): quick alignment: drafting a Q3 slice for the Inference Efficiency Advisor (batching, KV caching hints, quant recommendations, eval-trigger alerts). I propose three launch tracks with different guardrails. Need pushback on acceptance metrics & pilot plan.
Carlos (Eng): good. call out infra primitives we must land beforehand (lightweight prefix-cache API, batching coordinator, quant-safety shim). estimate effort for each please.
Ivy (ML): add an explicit concordance metric per model + per-customer baseline check. recommend nightly job that computes %output-drift; flag anything >1.5% for review.
Sam (Solutions): field teams want a simple customer ROI snapshot. propose a CSV template: avg_tokens_per_session, sessions_per_day, cost_per_token, expected_pct_reduction. SEs will fill it in during demos.
Priya (PM): okay here's the three tracks I'm thinking (different names than earlier threads):

Track: Starter (fast-facing)
- Audience: self-serve devs and small pilots
- Surface: passive recommendations in Console, single-click batching presets, downloadable ROI CSV template
- Acceptance: feature-flag, <1 extra API call for recommendations, basic telemetry events for uptake and apply-rate
- Success metric: pilot customers see >=7% token reduction on their top-10 flows
- Risks: suggestion noise for edge prompts

Track: Control Plane (configurable)
- Audience: infra/platform teams
- Surface: batching policy DSL, KV-prefix caching rules, safe quant suggestion UI, nightly eval-alerts with severity tags to Console/Sentry
- Acceptance: ability to mute per-tenant, documented SLO tradeoffs, visible eval diffs (sample-level) in UI and logs
- Success metric: achievable 18-30% cost savings on batched workloads, with <0.5% production quality regressions as measured by concordance checks
- Risks: extra ops tuning (autoscaling / batching latency windows)

Track: Safeguarded Enterprise
- Audience: dedicated capacity / private installs requiring controls
- Surface: recommendation API, tenant canary, signed quant diff reports, auto-hold + approval flow, audit trail, KMS-friendly keying for on-prem
- Acceptance: security review, audit-log completeness, SLI thresholds that trigger automatic rollback, integration tests for KMS paths
- Success metric: 25-50% sustained cost reduction on hot flows while staying within negotiated p99 latency targets
- Risks: compliance work, longer verification cycles

Carlos (Eng): sample batching policy DSL for Control Plane to help estimate complexity: """
batch_policy: 
  name: convo_session
  grouping_key: user_id
  max_wait_ms: 60
  max_batch_tokens: 3000
  latency_sla_ms: 200
"""
Ivy (ML): sample quant-safety check pseudocode for nightly job: """
orig = run_model(val_set)
quant = run_model_quant(val_set, config)
concordance = compute_similarity(orig, quant) # percent of identical or semantically-equivalent outputs
if concordance < 98.5:
  create_ticket('quant_alert', metadata=summary_stats)
  mark_candidate_for_manual_review
"""
Sam (Solutions): ROI template example attached in doc; fields + sample values for Shoply and AcmeHealth. recommend SE can run a quick calc in-chat during demos. long-term: embed a one-click estimator in Console.
Ruth (ProdOps): we need an eval-alert taxonomy: sample-level (data skew), model-level (concordance drop), infra-level (batching latency spike). map to response playbooks (info -> email digest, warn -> SE ping, critical -> page oncall).
Priya (PM): prioritization for Q3: pick two deliverables. my lean: Starter first, Control Plane second; enterprise track to Q4. any objections?
Carlos (Eng): that order works. but mark prefix-cache and quant-safety shim as cross-track infra dependencies in the tickets. I'll block sprint capacity for them early.
Ivy (ML): agree. also recommend we run a small pilot with two willing customers (Shoply, AcmeHealth) under Control Plane to validate ROI and alert noise levels.
Sam (Solutions): I'll coordinate pilot recruitment and prepare two usage snapshots for assumptions.
Ruth (ProdOps): add checklist entries to stories: telemetry, eval-harness, SLI definitions, rollback runbook, KMS test cases. tag security and SRE for Control Plane and Enterprise tracks.
Priya (PM): action items: 
- Priya: finalize ROI CSV + quick-start pilot instructions (due Wed)
- Carlos: spike prefix-cache + batching coordinator protos (branch by Mon)
- Ivy: commit eval-harness + concordance job (draft Wed)
- Sam: SE one-pager + pilot outreach (demo Fri)
- Ruth: JIRA checklists + security/SRE tags (add today)
launch-bot: created OPT-842 Inference Efficiency Advisor Q3 scope (owner: Priya)
Priya (PM): will lock scope Friday EOD unless blockers. please raise anything here. keep customer-facing phrase concise: "Reduce inference cost safely with explainable recommendations."
Carlos (Eng): will surface any infra blockers by Thu.
Ivy (ML): putting a small harness together tomorrow.
Sam (Solutions): prepping sample numbers for pilots.
Ruth (ProdOps): adding checks and owners.
Priya (PM): thanks — closing thread unless objections.
